sessionName: Week 7 - Marketing campaigns and thought leadership
summary: George Berrington reviewed Meridian's marketing output with Chris and Leanne. Content has been generic lean material that does not speak to operating partners. We agreed a single quarterly campaign around the first 100 days after acquisition, led by Chris as the visible voice.

discussion.keyPoints: Leanne found 22 blog posts in the last year, mostly on lean tools, with negligible traffic. None mention PE or value creation.
Chris is well known among the three core PE houses but has almost no LinkedIn presence. He is willing to post if someone drafts for him.
Consent issue from week 2 still open; one client has agreed to an anonymised case study.

recommendations.recommendation: Run one campaign per quarter, starting with 'The first 100 days on the shop floor' aimed at operating partners.
Chris posts on LinkedIn twice a week, drafted by Leanne, focused on value-creation plan delivery.
Publish an annual benchmark report on operational performance in PE-backed manufacturers, surveying 50 portfolio companies.
Measure campaigns only on operating partner meetings booked, with a target of 6 per quarter.

actions.action: Draft the first four LinkedIn posts for Chris

nextFocus: Look at partnerships and referral routes beyond the three PE houses.
nextPreparation: Chris to list firms that have referred work in the last three years.

tests.question: What is the first campaign we agreed?
expectedFacts: The first 100 days on the shop floor

tests.question: How often will Chris post on LinkedIn?
Is the annual benchmark report agreed?
